facts.fact: At that session the CIL validated its public report for 2024, described as covering outreach on law n°001-2021/AN, compliance controls, and the handling of complaints and authorisation requests, with no counts given.
The CIL held its 6th ordinary plenary session of the year on 26 June 2025 in Ouagadougou, with its commissioners and technical directors, chaired by its president.
